description: This file defines Express routes for user analytics metrics, such as daily active users, users by department, active vs inactive counts, top active users, filters, and summary KPIs. It sets up route handlers with associated controller functions and includes Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: ensureUsersAnalyticsIndexes
methods.description: Initializes necessary database indexes for user analytics, called once during startup.

methods.name: dailyActive
methods.description: Handles retrieval of daily active user counts within a specified date range.

methods.name: byDepartment
methods.description: Handles retrieval of user counts grouped by department within a specified window.

methods.name: activeVsInactive
methods.description: Provides counts of active versus inactive users over a specified window.

methods.name: topActive
methods.description: Returns the most recent active users, optionally filtered and limited.

methods.name: getDistinctDepartments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of distinct non-empty department names from users collection.

methods.name: getDistinctOrganizations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of distinct non-empty organization IDs from users collection.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Provides KPIs like total active users, new users this week, inactive users, compliance percentage, WAU, and MAU metrics, with optional filters.
